title: Cataclysm in the Mortal Realm
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, an icy voice exploded in his Mental Sea—it was Han Lie's transmission, carrying undisguised threat: "Chen Nian is in my hands now. If you don't admit defeat within three breaths, I'll cripple one of her meridians first."

text.content: That cry of 'Chen Ji-gege' was like thunder in his ears, yet in the next instant it was violently severed by some invisible force. The lingering echo in his Mental Sea convulsed violently, as if someone had gouged out his heart and hastily stitched it back together. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat already soaking through his inner garment. Mo Xiansheng's faint silhouette materialized beside him, the old man's voice carrying rare gravity: "She sensed you, and you sensed her—but this moment of resonance is enough to leak the Tianji Record's aura for three thousand miles."

dialogue.content: Three thousand miles... Ling Yuan the old bastard won't let this opportunity pass.

text.content: Before the words even finished, a massive column of blood-colored light erupted from the direction of the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds. This was the result of Cang Yutian placing his piece—the ancient forbidden land that had slumbered for ten thousand years in the mortal realm had opened ahead of schedule, dense spiritual energy rushing outward like a tide. Thousands of miles away, transmission jade talismans from three major sects lit up simultaneously, followed by the appearances of powerful auras from the Xuanwu Sect and White Tiger Sect. The Tianqing Sect's mountain-protecting formation let out a shrill alarm, throwing the entire Inner Sect into chaos.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! The forbidden grounds' strange changes have spread to the outer sect area, and unidentified cultivators have invaded in the chaos!

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice in the transmission talisman carried uncontrollable tension. At the same time, another transmission talisman lit up—it was from Ye Qing, her voice lacking its usual languor and gaining several sharp edges: "Chen Ji, the aftershock of the forbidden grounds' opening has attracted people from the Holy Sect. They're looking for that thing." Chen Ji gripped the two transmission talismans, his knuckles turning white. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: "Ling Yuan has already made his move. If you divert your attention to check on Su Qingyao, his layout regarding the Tianji Record will seize the opening. If you stay here, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing will each fight alone—disaster is inevitable."

The Tianqing Sect's outer sect had turned into a修罗场 at this moment. Su Qingyao in her azure robes stood before the collapsed main hall, sword drawn, sword aura sweeping three zhang. Seven black-clad attackers surrounded her, each at late Foundation Building cultivation—far exceeding her current distracted and exhausted state. The leader licked his lips: "Inner Disciple Senior Fellow? Not so impressive after all. Hand over the clues to the Tianji Record obediently, and the Holy Sect can spare your life." Su Qingyao coldly smiled, the tip of her sword slightly raised: "Want it? Come take it yourself."

Meanwhile, in a hidden valley somewhere in the mortal realm, Ye Qing was confronting three Holy Sect elders. Demonic energy churned around her as she barely maintained a barrier, but cracks were spreading across that barrier at visible speed. The leading elder coldly smiled: "Your Highness the Saint, did you think cooperating with that waste would let you escape the Holy Sect? How naive." Ye Qing wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth, a fierce glint flashing in her eyes: "Whether I can escape or not, you'll know when Chen Ji arrives."

dialogue.content: Across layers of space, Ling Yuan's old and cold voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Little waste, you've hidden deep enough. That Tianji Record aura just now—you couldn't hide it from this old man."

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, his expression terrifyingly calm. He slowly raised his head, his gaze seeming to penetrate this realm and look toward some invisible chessboard. Mo Xiansheng floated at his side, whispering: "Ling Yuan is deducing the Tianji Record's operational pattern. Every moment that passes, he sees more." The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest pulsed with gentle warmth—that was his only trump card for glimpsing the future. But every use meant the loss of Heavenly Fate, drawing him closer to destiny's inevitable deadly backlash.

choice.prompt: Both battlefields were crying for help. Chen Ji had to make a choice within limited time. Divide his attention to handle both, or focus on responding to Ling Yuan's threat?

choices.text: Split forces, attend to the mortal realm
choices.description: Briefly use the Tianji Record to peer into both battlefields, transmit crucial information to Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, let them handle things themselves, while delaying Ling Yuan's deduction.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing receive critical warnings, each化解ing a lethal crisis
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan gains more time to deduce the Tianji Record, increasing future threats

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his finger pressing against the Tianji Record Fragment. A faint golden light emanated from the fragment, seeping into his Brow Center. Within three breaths, he saw two of the seven before Su Qingyao carried hidden injuries—an old ailment below their left ribs that would flare on the sixth sword strike. He also saw a hidden spatial rift three zhang behind Ye Qing, a remnant from the forbidden grounds' opening. The cost was a sharp pang in his chest as Heavenly Fate drained once more.

choices.text: Focus on response, suppress Ling Yuan
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to counter Ling Yuan's deduction erosion, activate the ancient prohibition remnants within the fragment to backlash his窥视, temporarily abandon both mortal realm battlefields.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing each bear pressure, may be injured
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's deduction is forcibly interrupted, the Tianji Record's secret temporarily preserved
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing will each endure greater pressure and injury

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond to Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's transmissions. Instead, he immersed his entire being into the Tianji Record. The golden patterns on the fragment violently trembled as he forcibly activated an ancient prohibition. A muffled grunt came from Ling Yuan's direction—he was clearly injured in his spiritual consciousness by this backlash. But Chen Ji's face also paled—he sensed Su Qingyao's sword aura suddenly falter, and another crack forming in Ye Qing's barrier.

choices.description: Deliberately let Ling Yuan 'deduce' a false Tianji Record operational pattern, while sending a substitute talisman to each mortal realm battlefield, letting the substitutes absorb the first wave of attacks.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan obtains wrong deduction results, will use this as a stronghold to set up counter-kill later; both battlefields get breathing room
choices.risk_hint: Substitute talismans are precious and cannot be replenished in a short time after consumption
choices.process_label: 投放替身符箓·反向误导

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He took out two pale golden talismans from his storage bag, activated them with his spiritual consciousness, then let them transform into two streams of light flying toward both mortal realm battlefields. Meanwhile, he deliberately 'adjusted' the Tianji Record's aura into a specific fluctuation, letting Ling Yuan's deduction capture a seemingly complete but actually distorted pattern. "Old thing, want to peek at my trump card?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, "Then I'll let you see all you want."

However, no matter what Chen Ji chose, the fluctuations of Heavenly Secrets could no longer be completely concealed. A sinister laughter echoed from Ling Yuan's direction: "No matter. Whichever you choose is wrong. This old man has been setting pieces for three hundred years—how could a mere kid see through it?" As the words fell, a powerful pressure surged from the depths of the Tianqing Sect. That was the precursor to Ling Yuan's remnant soul本体 personally making a move. Meanwhile, the forbidden grounds' opening in the mortal realm had attracted more and more covetous parties. Nascent Soul elders from three major sects had already begun heading here. A larger-scale chaos was about to erupt.

On Su Qingyao's side, the substitute talisman's golden light briefly merged with her true body, blocking a lethal strike for her. But the talisman's power lasted only three breaths before being exhausted. She took the chance to severely wound two enemies, but was also injured by the shockwave to her right arm. Blood dripped down her arm, yet she gritted her teeth and didn't retreat. Her swordsmanship became even more fierce—"Chen Ji, remember this. Next time you make me handle things alone, and we'll have words!"

dialogue.content: On Ye Qing's side, the substitute talisman's power helped her find that spatial rift exactly. She gritted her teeth and detonated the residual forbidden lands' power within the rift, dragging all three elders into the spatial turbulence simultaneously. "Chen Ji..." She wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth, a complex glint flickering in her eyes, "You really did calculate everything. But next time, don't make me wait too long."

text.content: Both battlefields temporarily stabilized, but Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his ear, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Ling Yuan has already deduced sixty percent of the Tianji Record's third-layer operational pattern. Give him another half hour, and he can lock onto the blood resonance point between you and your sister." Chen Ji sharply raised his head, a cold killing intent flashing in his eyes—if Ling Yuan found Chen Nian's location, she would become fish on a chopping block.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan presses step by step. Chen Nian's location could be exposed at any moment. Chen Ji must make a decision—risk activating the Tianji Record's deeper abilities to cut off the deduction, or is there another way to break the deadlock?

choices.text: Forced severance, trading life for life
choices.description: Without hesitation, consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, forcibly activate the Tianji Record's backlash mechanism, severely injuring both Ling Yuan's deduction and his remnant soul.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's remnant soul severely wounded, unable to deduce the Tianji Record again for at least three years; buying time for Chen Nian to be safely relocated
choices.risk_hint: Sudden drop in Heavenly Fate will accelerate destiny's inevitable deadly backlash. The backlash will double the next time the Tianji Record is used

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against his Brow Center, using his own refined blood as a guide, forcibly activating the sleeping prohibition within the fragment. An invisible wave spread in all directions. Wherever it passed, Ling Yuan's deduction power dissolved like snow meeting boiling water. A shrill scream echoed from afar—that was Ling Yuan's remnant soul being severely wounded. But Chen Ji also felt a sharp pain in his chest, as if something was accelerating its departure from his body.

choices.text: Turn the tables, set a lethal trap
choices.description: Deliberately let Ling Yuan 'deduce' a false location—there lies an ancient killing formation Chen Ji prepared in advance. When he sends people for a massive attack, they'll be wiped out in one fell swoop.
choices.visible_cost: Need to abandon subsequent support for both mortal realm battlefields
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's forces will suffer devastating strikes, temporarily unable to act against Chen Ji again
choices.risk_hint: This plan requires time to set up. During this period, Chen Nian's location still has exposure risk

text.content: A cold smile curled on Chen Ji's lips. Using the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium, he deliberately created a false 'blood resonance point,' projecting it to a valley a hundred li east of the Tianqing Sect. There, that was where he had arranged an ancient killing formation three months ago. "Want to find my sister?" Chen Ji murmured quietly, "Then taste the greeting I prepared for her first."

Just as Chen Ji was plotting his counterattack, a sudden change occurred. A cold transmission appeared without warning in his Mental Sea. That voice was rough and arrogant, carrying undisguised threat: "You're Chen Ji, right? Chen Nian is in my hands. Within three breaths, admit defeat, or I'll cripple one of her meridians first." It was Han Lie. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, his knuckles cracking. Han Lie's voice continued, with cruel amusement: "What, surprised? You think you're the only one playing the long game? From the day that waste woman was taken by the Holy Sect, I've had my eyes on her. Graciously admit defeat in your pathetic chess game, otherwise..."

The transmission cut off abruptly. Chen Ji stood in place, his face betraying no expression, but Mo Xiansheng was unusually silent for three breaths before speaking quietly: "Han Lie... this person is not simple. Standing behind him isn't just the Xuanwu Sect." Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest violently pulsed, as if sensing its master's raging fury. He memorized this moment, Han Lie's voice, everyone involved in this affair. "Very well." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze ice-cold. "Excellent."

dialogue.content: Since you all want to play, then I'll play a big game with you.

text.content: At the entrance of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. Nascent Soul elders from three major sects had arrived—two of them were in heated argument with the Tianqing Sect elders over the forbidden grounds' ownership. Above the forbidden grounds, black clouds pressed down on the city, spiritual energy chaotic to the extreme. In the distance, more powerful auras were approaching—Demonic Path cultivators, rogue cultivators, even the legendary forbidden grounds guardians were drawn by this earth-shaking commotion. The barrier between the mortal realm and the cultivation world was visibly crumbling in this chaos. Chen Ji stood atop the tallest hall of the Tianqing Sect, overlooking all of this. Deep in his eyes was a coldness and calculation utterly out of place in this tumultuous world.

Mo Xiansheng floated at his side, the old man's voice carrying a complex tone: "Young master, the grand chess game has reached the middle game. Your sister is in Han Lie's grasp, Ling Yuan lurks in the shadows watching, and it seems the布局 of the Eyes of Heaven's Mandate has深入其中. This round... is more dangerous than this old man anticipated." Chen Ji gave no answer. His gaze越过 this chaos before him, looking toward some distant, unknowable direction—there, Chen Nian was in unknown danger. "I will find you." He silently said in his heart. "No one will use you to threaten me."
